name: 5x5-iron-simple-tracker
description: Offline-first 5x5 progressive overload & custom workout strength tracker with Android Health Connect integration.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run sync:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release-apk: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:release-aab: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
